title: Yellowed Russian Egg Noodles
description: A traditional Russian dish featuring egg noodles with a floral twist, perfect for a solo dinner, this recipe is macrobiotic-friendly and has an al-dente finish.

ingredients.name: Egg noodles
ingredients.notes: preferably made with egg and wheat flour

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the egg noodles according to package instructions until al-dente.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the dried dill, dried chamomile, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 2 minutes.
Drain the cooked egg noodles and return them to the pot.
Add the butter and herb mixture to the noodles and toss to combine.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the noodles and toss again to combine.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
